gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-montagu-slab: Ethnocentric pushes its letters apart, fast and aggressive. Montagu Slab, a text serif, has a sizable x-height that lets it sit at a modest size, robust downstrokes against slender turns.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-noto-serif-he: Aggressive Ethnocentric runs fast, with short ascenders over big bowls. Noto Serif Hentaigana adds subtle but visible stroke modulation, a refined, traditional counterweight to that bluntness on the page.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-ovo: Ovo sets a classic, authoritative tone with thins only slightly lighter than its thicks and a tall middle band. Ethnocentric, fast and aggressive, supplies all the speed up top.
gen-dafont-existence-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads literary and dignified, its tall middle band keeping ascenders and descenders shallow. Fauna One looks softer still beside Existence, whose letters are outlined at one steady thickness.
gen-dafont-existence-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads refined and editorial, with big counters in tall lowercase. Existence does industrial punch with a constant stroke weight, while the text below does the patient talking through wide, unclosed mouths.
gen-dafont-existence-gf-hanuman: Traditional is the first impression, helped by a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s. Hanuman, a text serif, is the real draw, softening Existence's industrial edge without arguing with it.
gen-dafont-existence-gf-kadwa: Existence draws round bowls whose walls never swell or taper. Kadwa, a serif with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height, should read in a classic, editorial way, paragraph after paragraph.
gen-dafont-existence-gf-noticia-text: Literary and dignified, Noticia Text enters each curve through a wide, visible entrance, its lowercase filling most of the letter height. Existence earns its keep when big and short, in a word or two.
gen-dafont-existence-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla reads refined and authoritative, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals in height. And that e, opened like a pried clasp, should keep text moving smoothly beneath Existence's one-stylus strokes.
gen-dafont-existence-gf-pridi: Pridi, a text serif, stands its small letters proud, almost capital-sized, with generous curve ends. But Existence skims along on an unchanging stroke weight, giving Pridi's classic, refined text an industrial counterpart.
